# fsevent-sys 4.1.0: inactive fully lazy framework diagnostic

Upstream: <https://github.com/octplane/fsevent-rust/tree/master/fsevent-sys>. Copyright and MIT license remain in LICENSE. This package is NOT patched into the product workspace; only the manual comparison workflow opts in through runner-only Cargo configuration.

The original FSEvents ABI, constants and context layouts remain intact. Both official umbrella frameworks (CoreServices and CoreFoundation) open on demand at their system absolute paths using dlopen RTLD_NOW|RTLD_LOCAL. OnceLock publishes only a complete typed symbol table; handles are retained until process exit, including partial-load failure, and events never repeat symbol lookup or poll. Missing framework/symbol errors return normally through ensure_loaded(). C wrappers cannot panic or call null symbols; their neutral error returns supplement preflight rather than replace it.

CoreFoundation exported DATA requires distinct treatment: type_array_callbacks() returns the address of Apple's immutable kCFTypeArrayCallBacks structure; run_loop_default_mode() dereferences the address of Apple's exported CFStringRef pointer. Neither invents or mutates a replacement global. The vendored notify constructor preflights both tables and uses these two accessors before any native watch allocation. This covers all RecommendedWatcher constructors, including Paradox's foreground runtime and background launch waiter, without changing the product sources.

Native tests resolve the complete tables, report nonexistent symbols, exercise real DATA with an array/string ownership roundtrip, and verify the default run-loop mode. Adoption requires a meaningful measured startup improvement, otool proof of neither eager framework, ordinary watcher/terminal/capture/footprint gates, and explicit review. The package remains its own isolated workspace.
